purpose: Adapters for nineteenth-century microscope-slide assemblages recovered through deep search, including cabinet, instrument, thin-section, and later-rediscovery contexts.
guards: Do not infer that all components in a present museum parent record formed one historical assemblage unless the source establishes that provenance.
Preserve unknown maker/acquisition routes explicitly instead of filling them from associated collectors.
Keep geological thin sections, microphotographs, biological preparations, and instrument-component slides as distinct media subtypes.

adapters.target: official curatorial story and geological-slide catalogue discovery for Heddle/Blarney material
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the specific slide, probable date, Heddle collection attribution, handwritten-ledger context and later rediscovery; leave maker and acquisition route null where the source says they are unknown.

adapters.target: bounded historical microscope-slide cabinets and instrument-plus-slide parent/child records
adapters.promotion_rule: Traverse the advertised parent/part hierarchy and keep cabinet, instrument, microphotograph and slide components separate; never promote current parent grouping into original historical association without evidence.
